'''Tyvark Luowan's Rodian Surprises''', also known as '''Tyvark's Shop''', was a store located in the Ahto East Central part of [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. The shop was owned by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Tyvark Luowan]] and it was operated during the [[Jedi Civil War]].

==Description==
Tyvark Luowan's Rodian Surprises,<ref name="Guide" /> or Tyvark's Shop,<ref name="KOTOR" /> was located in the Ahto East Central part of [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]] on<ref name="KOTOR" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="KotORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], near the exit to the [[City/Legends|city's]] West Central Courtyard. A general store, the establishment was a [[Color/Legends|gray]] octagonal room with walls lined vertically with piping. The floor, patterned with a circular design used throughout Ahto City, had a large central grill. To the left of the entrance was the kiosk used by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] owner [[Tyvark Luowan]], inset into the wall and lit up by eight wall lights. The top of the building was a circular shape held up by four projections from the walls, three of which contained lighting. Below the projection with no lighting were two grills that a [[Gas/Legends|gas]] came out of.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyvark Luowan's Rodian Surprises first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', a [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> released on [[July 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="Anniversary">{{SW|url=news/kotor-galaxy-of-heroes|text=BioWare and Capital Games on Bringing ''KotOR'' Fan Favorites into ''Galaxy of Heroes''|nolive=1}}</ref> The location was first named with the release of [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]], written by [[David Hodgson]]<ref name="Guide">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> and also released in [[July]] 2003.<ref name="Date">{{CargoBay|url=item-detail/12540|text=Knights of the Old Republic}}</ref> The book, however, misidentifies Tyvark Luowan as "Tyvark Ludwan" and carries over the misspelling to the name of his establishment.<ref name="Guide" /> This article follows the original spelling of the name provided in ''Knights of the Old Republic''.
